runtimeMapping.attacks: One WALK target. Attack/Attack_Down original .567, charged Skill_1_Attack .300 and S3 Skill_3_Attack .467, capped positive animation rate1. Original legal victim retained at CAST; dead inputs may be replaced. S1 full-charge mode follows max-SP checker; spent charge count is checked before all remaining SP is cleared.
runtimeMapping.s1: Charged modifier doubles the primary Physical attack. The separately applied extra Arts rider uses atk_scale_2 and does not emit source calculate-damage, so is not doubled. Charged stun precedes that rider. Native active-buff-before-primary ordering is mapped explicitly. Cancelled pending attacks clear their mode/locks; dead-input/no-emission refunds one charge.
runtimeMapping.shield: One own persistent dynamic barrier. Deployment snapshots current MAX_HP times born_hp_ratio. Kills and S3 recalculate cap using current MAX_HP and add selected kill/other amount up to300%; existing value is not rescaled or reduced when MAX_HP changes. S2 increases new gains only, not existing barrier or cap.
runtimeMapping.s2: Immediate Sanctuary Phys/Arts only and disarm. Source firstTriggerInterval .899999976 then interval1 on x-4 WALK-only current targets; pulses survive control because source isStunnable/isFreezable false. Original Skill_2 begins/loops/ends face Front.
runtimeMapping.s3: Add BAT .9, selected ATK and taunt level; one-time persistent shield addition. On end ATK/BAT/taunt revert while unspent shield remains. Begin/end use original clip durations.
runtimeMapping.retaliation: Enemy-source HP-damage receipts while own barrier remains trigger current-ATK Arts reflection with ordinary modifier/kill credit. Source T1 barrier/mark removal is mapped before T2 check: the receipt exhausting own shield does not reflect. External barriers alone, HP loss, element fill, cancelled/dodged inputs and friendly damage do not manufacture retaliation.

verificationLimits: Native compiled FSM, ToggleBuffSkillAvailableChecker dispatch, and automatic SP-consumption order are not executable. Full native charge ratio and post-first-consumption GE1 check map to selected two-charge readiness; fixed-step scheduling and mix duration do not claim frame parity.

Native T1 BlockDamage versus T2 InverseDamage same-priority callback order is not recovered as executable code. The mapped T1-first order checks remaining own barrier after absorption, including the breaking receipt; same-frame external shield/retaliation chains remain unverified.

ON_BUFF_START extra Arts/stun runs before the primary strike; source emitSourceOnCalculateDamage false is preserved by not applying charged multiplier to the extra rider. Native callback recursion and kill/target-free ordering remain bounded.

Own barrier snapshots initial value and uses current MAX_HP cap only on gain; external maxHP effects do not rescale existing barrier. Native floating-point/cap rounding and unrelated shield insertion priorities remain unverified.

S2 uses activation-anchored .9/1-second pulse phase; native attachment/mode-completion alignment is not frame-verified. Sanctuary follows recovered PHYSICAL_AND_MAGICAL mask and strongest owned effect.

Original Unity particle, audio, shield break and skill references are retained but not rendered; projectiles/effects remain placeholders. Modules and unreviewed cross-operator interactions are not enabled.
